project.name: Cascades Calgary three-phase automation
project.design_principle: Preserve the existing production-flow topology while automating handling, dispatch, routing, buffering and system coordination.

evidence_policy.B: Project proposal or controlled site document
evidence_policy.C: Observed site statement requiring survey confirmation
evidence_policy.D: Generic benchmark; never a Calgary guarantee
evidence_policy.E: Engineering estimate requiring simulation or test
rules: Do not present proposal values as verified OEM performance.
Do not present generic Ingetrans or AMR benchmarks as Calgary outcomes.
Do not publish ROI or payback until installed CAPEX and reconciled annual benefits are approved.
Do not add labor savings across phases unless role, shift and task IDs are unique.

current_state.layout: WIP on east side; converting equipment on west side; north-south transfers connect WIP, first pass, second pass and shipping.
second_pass_machines: Automatic Two-Piece Folder Gluer and Stitcher Inline Machine
handling: Three non-automated metal roller conveyor outputs
Manual north-south transfer pushed by operators
Manual routing to second pass or shipping
principal_losses_to_measure: converter blocked time waiting for output clearance
manual transfer travel and handling time
queue age and WIP search time

phases.name: Automated outputs, transfer and AGV-ready shipping
scope: Automate and coordinate the three first-pass output roller conveyors
Automate the north-south transfer under the same INGECART control layer
Route jobs to FG miniline, Two-Piece line or shipping by software
Install a trident interface for AGV load and unload at shipping
Integrate status, job identity, interlocks and exception management
phases.expected_mechanism: Remove manual dispatch and transfer delay while preserving the same source, destination and second-pass alternatives.

phases.name: Plug and Play palletizing expansion
scope: Deploy compact robotic palletizing cells on selected EMBA and Martin lines
Standardize recipes, pallet quality, interlayers and production records
Connect line status and completed-load calls to the common software layer
Prepare finished loads for controlled downstream pickup
phases.expected_mechanism: Stabilize end-of-line evacuation and pallet quality without changing machine sequence or product routing.

published_local_product_page_values.classification: local INGECART product page; confirm in signed technical offer and FAT

acceptance_kpis: sustained bundles per minute by SKU family
line blocked time caused by palletizer

phases.name: Plant-wide Ingetrans and AMR orchestration
scope: Extend automated transport between WIP, converting, finished-goods outputs and shipping
Introduce AMR transport and trident handoff stations where validated
Coordinate priorities, routes, charging, traffic and exceptions through WCS and fleet management
Integrate ERP/APS, MES/WMS, INGECART WCS, fleet manager and machine PLC events
Use simulation to size fleet, buffers and degraded modes before procurement
phases.expected_mechanism: Digitally orchestrate the existing plant routes and buffers, reducing line starvation, uncontrolled WIP and transport variability.
official_kuka_capabilities: real-time obstacle avoidance and route replanning
job and traffic management in one environment
standard API integration with WMS and ERP/MES
payload families from 250 kg to heavy-duty platforms
acceptance_kpis: manual forklift and transfer movements displaced

control_architecture: ERP/APS: orders, due dates and production priorities
MES/WMS: job state, inventory identity and location
INGECART WCS/flow orchestrator: transport demand, route policy, reservations and exceptions
Fleet manager and transfer PLCs: missions, traffic, charging and station handshakes
Physical stations: conveyors, transfer, tridents, palletizers, AMRs and safety devices

required_inputs: installed CAPEX by phase including engineering, installation, safety, IT/OT and contingency
annual maintenance, software and support OPEX
approved loaded labor cost and unique displaced task-hours by role and shift
baseline throughput, blocked time, starvation, waste and damage
validated post-change KPI ranges from simulation, FAT and SAT
production calendar, ramp-up curve and discount rate

scenario_method.low: Use p25 validated benefit and p75 cost; include conservative ramp-up.
scenario_method.base: Use median validated benefit and approved expected cost.
scenario_method.high: Use p75 validated benefit and p25 cost; label as upside, not commitment.

business_case.decision_rule: No numeric ROI claim while any required input is unknown or duplicated.

gates.evidence: time study, PLC history, production records and role-task matrix
surveyed layout, controls narrative, risk assessment and simulation
SKU matrix, throughput, handshakes, fault recovery and data integration
site KPI comparison over representative production window
benefits ledger, open-risk review and approved business case

sources.use: AMR payload families, navigation, safety, charging and connectivity
fleet orchestration, VDA 5050, API, PLC and ERP/MES integration
general integration, robotic palletizing and end-to-end project capability
local product positioning and provisional target values
generic scenario structure only; not calibrated Calgary performance
